name: catalogue-service
description: Owns the catalogue: titles and their physical copies (status available, on-loan, on-hold, withdrawn), with title search and per-title availability counts, persisted in its own Postgres. Deployed separately because the requirements make the catalogue its own service; only the circulation API calls it, over the intranet. It does not know about members, loans, holds or fees, and does no sign-in handling itself.
